name: freeverb
description: Freeverb as the master reverb: the reverb object's update() runs Freeverb (public domain) instead of the stock reverb, driven by the same Master Reverb knobs

branches.note: Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); also resets Freeverb's start-up state at every start

words.note: master reverb object vtable: update method 0x60031e5d -> mt_fv_update (Freeverb)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_fv_pattern_update (the unit has booted: Freeverb may start)
